primary_row: variant p5 (patched translator, census/fork patches i-v), mode shipped: one Charon run, one Aeneas run, nothing marked or removed

definitions.function: a non-test `fn` with a body in rust/protocol/src found by census/tools/fninv (the census inventory), origin 'source'
definitions.counted: a function that is present in Charon's output, or all functions when Charon gives no output (census/scripts/report.py: stage != 'absent')
definitions.stopped_at: census/scripts/report.py stage_of(): charon / aeneas / lean / ok (through)
definitions.translates: stage == ok: the function, including the body of an async fn, ends as Lean that compiles (no axiom, no sorry for it)
definitions.no_axiom_beneath: census field ok_closure_no_axiom: the function and every local function it calls compile, and none of them uses an axiom
definitions.share: ok_closure_no_axiom functions / counted functions; also reported over all source functions

informational_only.side_rows: pinned (unpatched release Aeneas on the same LLBC); cw (Charon-side workarounds) only if the shipped row gives no LLBC

criterion.not_a_route_a_target_if: none of the three entry points translate AND share_no_axiom_beneath < 0.10
criterion.evaluated_on: the primary row; if a cw row is run it is evaluated and stated as well, and the call is 'not a Route A target' only if it holds on every row run with the patched translator
